title: My Boss Paid Me in Exposure 🦊
description: An original animated office comedy. A fox discovers what 'exposure' really pays. #Shorts #Animation #Comedy

segments.text: My paycheck? Zero dollars. My boss called it exposure!
So I shared his Wi-Fi password with everyone.
He yelled, You're fired! Great, I said. More exposure!
I offered my landlord exposure instead of rent. He changed the locks.
